comments.comment: Very accurate. It takes several months for a fetus to take shape.

The image shows the gestational sac with chorionic villi (early placenta) and the amniotic sac – the protective and supporting structures around the embryo. At 6–9 weeks, the embryo is only a few millimeters to about 2 cm in size, so it is often hidden in the tissue or fragmented after a miscarriage or abortion. At this stage, the embryo already has a heartbeat, limbs, and first movements.
This pictures are FAKE. Please just search “9 weeks fetus”, and you will find a perfect baby with eyes, legs and arms!

Just FYI, these pictures have been proven to be showing only the gestational sack, with the embryo and blood removed. Pro-choice women, women who have suffered miscarriages at these stages and have seen their babies with their own eyes, as well as embryologists have come out and rightly condemned these images as lies. Go to The Endowment for Human Development's website, ehd.org, to see *real*, *unadulterated* images and video of human beings all through pregnancy, even at the very earliest stages.

I’m sorry but I birthed my 9 week fetus still in the sack in a spontaneous miscarriage. I held it in my hand and it was a tiny human. I have also had a medical abortion to end a “missed miscarriage” so completely understand that miscarriages are necessary but this is misleading.
